plugin.AddRequestHeader.detail: Add custom HTTP headers to downstream requests passing through this route. For example: add authentication info, trace ID, or custom metadata. Supports static values and dynamic expressions.
plugin.SetRequestHeader.detail: Set (replace) HTTP header in downstream requests. If the header exists, its value is replaced; if not, it is added. Used to override headers passed by the client.
plugin.RemoveRequestHeader.detail: Remove specified HTTP header from downstream requests. Commonly used to remove sensitive headers (like Cookie) or clean up unwanted headers.
plugin.AddRequestParameter.detail: Add query parameters to request URLs passing through this route. Suitable for adding tenant IDs, API versions, or other common parameters.
plugin.RemoveRequestParameter.detail: Remove specified query parameter from request URLs. Used to clean sensitive parameters or standardize request format.
plugin.AddResponseHeader.detail: Add custom HTTP headers to client responses. Can be used to add security headers, performance metrics, or debugging information.
plugin.SetResponseHeader.detail: Set (replace) HTTP response headers returned to the client. Used to modify or standardize response header information.
plugin.RemoveResponseHeader.detail: Remove specified HTTP header from client responses. Commonly used to remove server information or sensitive headers.
plugin.StripPrefix.detail: Strip specified number of prefix segments from request path. For example: /api/v1/users → /users (strip 2 levels). Suitable for API versioning scenarios.
plugin.PrefixPath.detail: Add fixed prefix to request path. For example: /users → /api/v1/users. Used for unified API path conventions.
plugin.RewritePath.detail: Rewrite request path using Java regular expressions. Supports capture groups and backreferences. Powerful path transformation tool for complex routing scenarios.
plugin.SetPath.detail: Completely replace request path. Supports URI template variables (like {segment}). Used to fundamentally change the request target path.
plugin.SetStatus.detail: Set HTTP status code returned to client. Used for custom response status, like changing 404 to 200 or success to a specific status.
plugin.RedirectTo.detail: Redirect requests to a specified URL with an HTTP status code (e.g., 301 for permanent redirect, 302 for temporary redirect). Useful for URL migration or maintenance pages.
plugin.SecureHeaders.detail: Automatically add security headers to responses, including XSS protection, content type options, frame options, HSTS, etc. Helps protect against common web vulnerabilities.
plugin.RequestSize.detail: Limit the maximum size of request body. Requests exceeding the limit will be rejected. Helps prevent DoS attacks and control resource usage. Format: 1KB, 1MB, 1GB, etc.
predicate.Path.detail: Match requests by URL path pattern. Supports Spring Ant-style patterns: ? (single char), * (any chars except /), ** (any chars including /). Example: /api/** matches all paths under /api/.
predicate.Host.detail: Match requests by Host header. Supports Ant-style patterns like *.example.com to match all subdomains. Useful for multi-tenant routing based on domain.
predicate.Method.detail: Match requests by HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, OPTIONS). Supports multiple methods. Useful for API method restrictions.
predicate.Header.detail: Match requests by HTTP header presence or value. Supports regular expressions for value matching. Example: X-Request-Id matches header presence, X-Request-Id=\d+ matches header value pattern.
